description:
Cause a noncreature artifact to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be an Equipment due to Dan Lewis if it isn't an Equipment already, causing Chishiro to trigger.
Resolve Chishiro's first ability, creating a 2/2 red Spirit creature token with menace plus an additional artifact token through Peregrin Took, which will be an Equipment due to Dan Lewis. Each relevant ability of Chishiro triggers.
Repeat from step 2.
